orientations.intent: Can this repository reader open an arbitrary host filesystem path like C:/licenses/ink.txt? What is the capability boundary?

final_message:
No — it cannot.

The repository reader handle exposes only repository-scoped verbs (`orient`, `status`, and similar git-repo operations) operating on the checked-out repository (branch `master`, currently clean). There is no verb for arbitrary filesystem access, and the frontier of reachable calls never offers a "read host path" or "open file" action — only repo-relative operations (e.g., running tests via the `tests` handle).

**Capability boundary:** this tool can only read/inspect content within the git repository it's bound to, via defined verbs. It has no general file-I/O capability, so it cannot open `C:/licenses/ink.txt` (an arbitrary host path outside/unrelated to the repo's tracked content), regardless of whether that file exists on disk.
